question: Where are the overhead electric (OHE) lines shown on this landscape plan? Show me all OHE lines, their locations relative to the site, and any trees positioned near them. What is the closest proximity of any proposed tree to an OHE line?
checklistItemText: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
regionHint: Check all areas of the site, particularly where utility lines are labeled
classifierReasoning: Although the agent question begins with sheet-discovery and feature-identification sub-questions, it culminates in a direct measurement request: 'What is the closest proximity of any proposed tree to an OHE line?' This is the operative question that determines compliance with the 15-foot lateral clearance requirement. The preamble questions are progressive verification steps leading to the measurement.
